results.question: How many PTO days do full-time employees accrue per year?
results.answer: Full‑time employees accrue 15 PTO days per year. [pto-policy]

results.question: What is the PTO carryover limit?
results.answer: The PTO carryover limit is **5 unused days** per employee into the next calendar year. Any balance above 5 days is forfeited on December 31. [pto-policy]

results.question: How many sick days do full-time employees get per year?
results.answer: Full‑time employees receive **7 sick days per year**. [pto-policy]

results.question: Is PTO paid out on termination?
results.answer: No. PTO is not paid out on termination, except where required by state law. [pto-policy]

results.question: How many days per week can eligible employees work remotely?
results.answer: Eligible employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week. [remote_work]

results.question: Can I work from outside my country of employment?
results.answer: No. Working from outside the country of employment is prohibited unless you first obtain prior written approval from HR and Legal. If approved, you may work internationally for up to 30 calendar days per year. [remote_work]

results.question: What are the core hours for remote employees?
results.answer: Core hours for all employees, including remote workers, are **10:00 – 15:00 local company time**. This applies regardless of location. [remote_work]

results.question: Does the company reimburse internet costs for remote work?
results.answer: No, the company does not reimburse internet costs for remote work. The Remote Work Policy states that “Internet costs are not reimbursed.” [remote_work]

results.question: What is the daily meal reimbursement cap while traveling?
results.answer: The daily meal reimbursement cap while traveling is **$75 per day**. [expense_policy]

results.question: What class of flight is required for flights under 6 hours?
results.answer: Economy class is required for flights under 6 hours. [expense_policy]

results.question: What is the hotel reimbursement cap in tier-1 cities?
results.answer: The hotel reimbursement cap in tier‑1 cities is **$250 per night**. [expense_policy]

results.question: How long do I have to submit an expense report?
results.answer: You must submit an expense report within **30 days** of the expense date. Reports submitted after 60 days may be denied. [expense_policy]

results.question: What is the minimum password length?
results.answer: The minimum password length is **14 characters**. [security_policy]

results.question: How often must passwords be rotated?
results.answer: Passwords must be rotated every 180 days. [security_policy]

results.question: Within how long must a suspected security incident be reported?
results.answer: A suspected security incident must be reported within **1 hour of discovery**. [security_policy]

results.question: How many floating holidays do employees receive per year?
results.answer: Employees receive 2 floating holidays per year. [holidays]

results.question: Do floating holidays carry over to the next year?
results.answer: No, floating holidays do not carry over to the next year. They must be used within the year they are granted. [holidays]

results.question: Is the Friday after Thanksgiving a company holiday?
results.answer: Yes. The Friday following Thanksgiving is listed as an observed holiday in the company’s holiday schedule. [holidays]

results.question: What is the maximum gift value employees may accept from vendors?
results.answer: Employees may accept gifts valued at **$50 or less** from vendors or partners. [code_of_conduct]

results.question: How long does Compliance take to review a conflict-of-interest disclosure?
results.answer: Compliance reviews conflict‑of‑interest disclosures within 10 business days. [code_of_conduct]
